## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23) is an early exegetical work forming part of the *Cūḷaniddesa* in the Khuddaka Nikāya. Translated as the "Exposition of the Rhinoceros Horn Discourse," the work provides a detailed word-by-word commentary and doctrinal exposition on the *Khaggavisāṇa Sutta* (Snp 1.3). The commentary on this text, the *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesavaṇṇanā*, is preserved as part of the Khuddaka Nikāya commentary (*KN-aṭṭhakathā* / *Saddhammapajjotikā*) [Schlosser 2016].

 In agreement with this distribution, DharmaNexus finds over 19,000 shared passages across 451 Pali works, demonstrating heavy internal text reuse primarily with *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa*, the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Saḷāyatana Saṁyutta* (SN 35), the *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa*, the *Suttanipāta-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Paccekabuddhaapadāna* (Tha-Ap 2) [DharmaNexus]. Cross-canonically, the underlying verses are cited or paralleled across numerous traditions, including the Gāndhārī *Rhinoceros Sūtra* (GF 5B), Chinese Āgama and Dharmapada parallels (e.g., SA 1176, MA 72, T 210.31), Sanskrit Udānavarga recensions (UV 14), and Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya literature. Furthermore, DharmaNexus generates cross-language alignments with Sanskrit and Tibetan treatises, notably Śāntideva's *Śikṣāsamuccaya*, the *Śrāvakabhūmi* of the *Yogācārabhūmi*, the *Vinayavastu*, and the *Arthaviniścayasūtra* [DharmaNexus].
